Name: Simple Journal Pin
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Journal Pin ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#86EFAC]Keep the quests you care about in view while you play.[/color][/b][/center]

[center]Pin up to [b]six Journal quests[/b] and follow their live objectives, item icons and progress on your HUD. Choose your own order, adjust the display and open a quest directly from the tracker.[/center]

[center][color=#FDE68A]PC 1.3 • One vertical list by default • Optional two-column layout • Settings inside the Journal[/color][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]📌 Your quests, at a glance[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484463-995424743.png[/img]
[center][b]Journal preview:[/b] native quest entries with pin checkboxes and a settings cog.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484474-1424274927.png[/img]
[center]Manually unpinned quests stay unpinned. Pinning never completes quests or spends items.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]📖 One vertical tracker by default
[/color][/b][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484486-369925663.png[/img][/center]

[center][b]Default layout:[/b] one vertical list containing all six pins and their objectives.[/center]

[center]Prefer a wider display? Enable [b]Two-column tracker[/b] in the Journal cog or optional Generic Mod Config Menu. It stays off until you choose it.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484498-538544486.png[/img][/center]
[center][b]Optional layout:[/b] the same six pins arranged in two columns. This is one tracker, with no paging.[/center]

[center]Both layouts keep every objective visible. Long objectives wrap; exceptionally dense quests or very small viewports may need smaller text to fit. Other movable HUD widgets can still overlap your chosen position.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]⚙ Compact settings, familiar controls
[/color][/b][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484509-1369501233.png[/img][/center]

[center][b]Settings preview:[/b] compact rows, plain checkboxes, thick gold tabs and Save / Cancel / Reset buttons.[/center]

[center]Use the [b]cogwheel above the Journal’s top-right corner[/b]. No extra menu mod is required. [color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color] is optional and provides the same preferences.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484522-1882664848.png[/img]
[center]The tracker never switches to two columns automatically. Both layouts show the same six pins; there are no tracker pages.[/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484533-825720026.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[center]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu retains its own Save/Cancel/Reset behaviour.
The show/hide shortcut works during ordinary gameplay with no menu or event open.[/center]

[center]The tracker’s gold minus/plus control hides or reopens its contents. Hidden quests keep updating in the background. Display settings and order belong to each farmer; the optional hotkey is shared through this mod’s config.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Native quests and Special Orders[/color][/b]
Supports standard Journal quests and Special Orders, including native structures used by Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp. Quest names, translations and item sprites come from the game or their source mods. Unknown objectives use their own quest text where possible.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Journal and UI mods[/color][/b]
Native rendering checks include Simple Journal Expansion, Deluxe Journal, Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2. The tracker leaves space for UI Info Suite 2 Alt status icons. Complete Journal replacements or quest systems outside the native quest lists may need their own integration.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Per-player tracking[/color][/b]
Each farmer keeps separate pins and preferences, including shared Special Orders. Split-screen tracking uses each player’s UI viewport. This display does not change the shared quest’s actual rules or progress.[/quote][/center]

[center]Validation used isolated native rendering and quest-data fixtures. Complete expansion/modpack playthroughs, multiplayer sessions and physical-controller testing remain unverified.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]PC edition:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later and [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/url][/color].
Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. No content packs or other Simple mods are required.[/center]

[center]1. Close the game and install SMAPI.
2. Extract the download.
3. Place the [b]SimpleJournalPin[/b] folder inside your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch through SMAPI, open the Journal and tick a quest checkbox.[/center]

[center]When updating, replace the mod files and keep your config.json. Saved pins and per-farmer preferences are retained. PC 1.3 starts with the vertical layout; you can enable two columns afterward.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]📱 Separate Android experiment[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Android 1.1 — device testing needed[/color][/b]
The separate Android candidate shows the first three pins as passive text below the top-left icons. It has no tracker frame, arrows or HUD click targets; manage all six saved pins and their order through the Journal settings. It was compiled against desktop references and has not been tested on an Android device. It requires a compatible game/SMAPI port; PC SMAPI requirements do not confirm Android support.[/quote][/center]

[center]Use [b]one edition at a time[/b]. PC and Android share the same mod ID. Android 1.1 is unchanged by this PC 1.3 update.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]💬 Good to know[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Does pinning change my quests?[/color][/b]
No. The mod records its own pins and display preferences in farmer modData. It does not complete quests, consume items or grant rewards. Carrying items is not the same as donating them, and return-to-speak objectives remain until the game completes the quest.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Can I remove it?[/color][/b]
Yes. Remove the SimpleJournalPin folder. Your quests, progress and unclaimed rewards remain in the normal Journal.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Languages[/color][/b]
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian. Quest wording follows the original game or mod’s translations.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Reporting an objective issue[/color][/b]
Include your SMAPI log, the quest name and a screenshot. For unsupported objectives, run sjp_dumpquests in the SMAPI console with a save loaded and include its read-only diagnostic report from this mod’s diagnostics folder.[/quote][/center]

[center]Interface previews use the native renderer with illustrative sample quests. Stardew Valley and its native artwork/fonts belong to ConcernedApe.[/center]
